cause: It explores by dumping the repo — `ls`/`find`/`glob`, then opening every sibling module — rather than reading only the files the spec and tests point at. It should let the spec and test file select the modules instead of enumerating the package.
subject: read_file lists the project files a read file imports.
description: I changed `src/tools/read.ts` so that `read_file` appends a short "Project files this imports: …" line when the file it read names project modules in import/include lines (Python `from pkg.table import …`, JS `from "./x"`, `require(...)`, etc.). Name matching keeps it small and language-agnostic, and a named package maps to its entry point (`pkg/__init__.py`, `index.js`). This addresses the cause directly: instead of globbing the package and opening every sibling module, the model reads the file the task points at (the spec/test), which now hands it the exact modules to open, so the spec and tests select the files to change. The extra line is tiny versus a full sibling read, so whenever it prevents even one exploratory read it also cuts cost. I verified the 10 failures are exactly the known sandbox ones, with no new test failures, and `tsc` passes.
